name: JoAi: Update Automation

description.en: Update name, enabled flag, trigger, or sending agent of a lifecycle automation. To replace actions use set_automation_actions. There is no delete — set enabled to 0.
description.de: Aktualisiert Name, enabled, Trigger oder Sende-Agent einer Automation. Aktionen ersetzen über set_automation_actions. Kein Löschen — enabled auf 0 setzen.
description.fr: Met à jour le nom, enabled, le déclencheur ou l'agent d'envoi. Pour remplacer les actions, utilisez set_automation_actions. Pas de suppression — mettez enabled à 0.
description.es: Actualiza nombre, enabled, trigger o agente de envío. Para sustituir acciones usa set_automation_actions. No hay borrado — pon enabled en 0.
description.it: Aggiorna nome, enabled, trigger o agente di invio. Per sostituire le azioni usa set_automation_actions. Nessuna eliminazione — imposta enabled a 0.
description.ro: Actualizează numele, enabled, triggerul sau agentul de trimitere. Pentru acțiuni folosește set_automation_actions. Nu există ștergere — setează enabled pe 0.

bot: Pass automationId hashid. To replace actions use set_automation_actions. To disable: enabled=0. To permanently remove with no active enrollments: delete_automation. enabled: pass 1 or 0.

inputs.name: Enabled
inputs.bot: Pass 1 or 0 (or true/false). Use 0 to disable (no delete in v1).

inputs.name: Agent ID
inputs.bot: Optional sending agent UUID. Pass empty string to clear.

error.fr: Échec de la mise à jour de l'automatisation : {{MESSAGE}}
error.es: No se pudo actualizar la automatización: {{MESSAGE}}
